description: Security-relevant defaults are judged only where the surrounding configuration makes the absence knowable: an inline JWT payload enumerates every possible claim, and a named secret option visibly falls back to a literal. Payloads built elsewhere are silent.

expected.note: the fallback is selected exactly when SESSION_SECRET is absent, and the neighbouring port option shows this is application configuration
the inline payload enumerates its claims and has no exp; the omitted options argument therefore proves there is no expiresIn either
